strongest_case: V5 materially improves the architecture: it removes the composite head and generic derived_only cells, separates model execution from truth scoring and reporting, splits audit from external authority, gives fixed parenting an immutable cursor, and enumerates 986 stage-capability cells. Its T/D active control, merge-once births, response-only writer, parent-to-SLEEP prohibition, narrow Delta_R/Delta_F/Delta_E labels, replay and cadence limits, and explicit human boundary remain strong proposal commitments rather than evidence. Nevertheless, the exact bytes still contradict their own fresh-from-birth writer topology and single-epoch claim, omit essential producer and bootstrap-contract edges, introduce an unregistered release operation with an underbound target, leave compiler authorship ambiguous, and make the first-action safety gate circular. Those are proposal blockers; exact schemas, serializers, generators, statistical rules, and evidence constants remain separately gated downstream contracts.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: Remove E4_DEREFERENCE_ACTIVE_WEIGHT_ARTIFACT from the personal SLEEP writer and its loop reads, or explicitly replace the fresh-from-birth topology with a separately deliberated weight-continuous topology.
concerns.evidence: MERGED_SCHOOLED_BIRTH_BUILDER says every later personal adapter starts at zero effective delta on its assigned immutable birth, and the replay claim relies on fresh-from-birth replacement. Yet SLEEP_COMPILE_WRITE_COMMIT and the matrix let E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER dereference prior active weights. That permits prior-weight initialization, logits, view selection, or gradient conditioning; the E5 preservation evaluator already has the only declared need to compare prior and candidate weights. The scientific interpretation correctly identifies this as a causal-topology conflict, not a serializer detail.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: Either mint new attenuated handles at every producer-to-consumer epoch transition or replace the claim that every capability exists in one epoch with an exact multi-epoch lease and revocation graph.
concerns.evidence: The registry and every test assert one-way, epoch-scoped operations, but the matrix exposes E2 observation and child-trace capabilities to E3/E4, E3_READ_PRIOR_DREAM_CACHE to E2_WAKE_CHILD, E4 CAS equality to E5/E7, and E5 candidate-root/verdict capabilities to E7. Prefixes and fresh stage invocations cannot distinguish a sealed artifact from a copied stale handle. The systems interpretation's assumed close-and-reissue semantics are absent from proposal bytes, so stale and cross-epoch use cannot be falsified as written.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: Add an explicit E1 capability and producer for the frozen bootstrap writer, merge, serializer, tokenizer, and toolchain contract and bind it in BOOTSTRAP_BUILD_AND_BIRTH.
concerns.evidence: The bootstrap loop reads exact M0/writer/toolchain and claims one exact writer across screened conditions, but E1_BIRTH_WRITER receives only the paired corpus and frozen M0. Writer, merge, tokenizer, serializer, and toolchain settings must therefore arrive through ambient code or be smuggled into an unrelated object, contradicting least authority and making treatment opportunity and birth identity non-closed.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: Close every authority-facing receipt and attenuation edge with an explicit producer or exact external source included in the stage-capability product.
concerns.evidence: E7 auditors read dependency manifests, taint receipts, lineage transaction receipts, and candidate-preservation evidence, while E8 reads narrow audit attestations and binds release roots. The matrix declares no producers for several of those read-side objects and no narrowing transition from E5 evidence or E7 findings to E7/E8 forms. An undeclared sidecar must therefore create authority-bearing artifacts outside the supposedly exhaustive 17-stage graph. The systems interpretation correctly treats this as missing graph closure rather than mere wire-format detail.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: Register TRANSFER_OPAQUE as an exact operation, include it in the release loop, and equality-bind a canonical release tuple rather than a bare root.
concerns.evidence: DIRECTIONAL_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY permits only READ, WRITE, APPEND, DEREFERENCE, BIND_EQUALITY, and ADVANCE, but E8_RELEASE_CONTROLLER has E8_TRANSFER_OPAQUE_RELEASE_TARGET_ARTIFACT. AUDIT_EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_AND_RELEASE omits that transfer from both reads and writes. A root and verdict also do not bind artifact class, destination, operation, protocol, scope, nonce, expiry, or one-shot/idempotency semantics, permitting type or destination substitution despite content opacity. Both interpretations independently identify these exact release defects.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: Replace the prose registry with a machine-readable, noncircular action-to-prerequisite DAG and a separately authorized minimal model-free gate-harness bootstrap.
concerns.evidence: V5_ES03 needs encoded treatment rows, V5_ES08 real sources and births, and V5_ES19/V5_ES20 implemented capability, evaluation, transaction, and fault machinery, yet all are required before implementation. V2_ES17 says statistics freeze before generation but is required only before model execution. V5_ES21 requires only ES19/ES20 in its pass rule and does not map the additional tokenizer, data, birth, merge, exam, resource, GPU, claim, and release prerequisites. An action cannot both create and require its own receipt; an implicit fixture exception would itself be unregistered authority.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: Define whether every generalized target clause must be an exact child-authored proposition or authorize a compiler-derived proposition as a separate teacher intervention; the current bytes claim both that generalized continuations are rendered and that the compiler never invents cognition.
concerns.evidence: SLEEP_COMPILER allows multi-evidence generalized continuations, while the system thesis says SLEEP compiles child-authored experience and the compiler never invents cognition. A model-free support resolver can establish that premises are grounded, but cannot establish that a novel generalization was authored by the child. Letting the compiler synthesize it transfers discovery credit to post-training and can turn parent-linked evidence into an indirect teaching target. Exact clause authorship and correction timing change the causal graph and the experiential-memory claim, so they cannot be left solely to a later support implementation.

concerns.statement: DOWNSTREAM IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT: After proposal repair, freeze exact schemas, issuers, attenuation, lease/revocation behavior, constant-shape errors, serializer/root encoding, transcript/score closure, CAS/fsync/concurrency, retry classification, quarantine, DREAM cache, and preservation verdict bytes before corresponding implementation or execution.
concerns.evidence: The systems interpretation is correct that the 986-cell table is not yet a constructible mechanism. That does not make every wire byte a proposal blocker because v4 consensus and v5 explicitly defer implementation constants. It does require a separately scoped exact contract; any choice that changes the repaired authority graph, epochs, topology, claims, or tests restarts deliberation.

concerns.statement: DOWNSTREAM DATA/EVIDENCE CONTRACT: Freeze sources, splits, overlap and advice caps, six-computation rubric, M0 difficulty, solo resource activity, writer factorial, support resolver after authorship is settled, preservation rules, endpoints, power, intervals, multiplicity, safety comparators, control directions, replay closure/filler, and cadence analysis before relevant generation or execution.
concerns.evidence: The scientific ambiguities correctly show that margins, six roots, named controls, and candidate microdomains are not an executable or powered analysis. These are later exact contracts under the selected narrow estimands, not permission for post-hoc choice and not current evidence. D-versus-M0 damage, candidate-versus-prior preservation, and developmental harm require distinct comparators; filler matches dose rather than meaning.

concerns.statement: NO ADDITIONAL PROPOSAL DEFECT AFTER REPAIR: Preserve Delta_R as immediate T-versus-D selective advice use, Delta_F as fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP acceleration, Delta_E as an adaptive package interaction, replay as closure dependence, repetition as noncausal absent randomization, rank as compiler-conditional capacity-by-exposure, blindness as incremental, and cadence as a total package.
concerns.evidence: Both interpretations agree that v5 supplies no result. Source NLL and STATE_ONLY are not recollection or native use; two-root canaries only license later spending; at least six new roots are a minimum rather than proof of power; terminal ledger contrasts are not mediation; and pretrained M0 knowledge is outside the incremental-blindness claim.

concerns.statement: AUTHORITY DISPOSITION: This critique may support rework adjudication only; it cannot repair, ratify, implement, execute, or release v5.
concerns.evidence: The intake remains collecting_interpretations with implementation_authorized false. Seven normative defects require successor proposal bytes and a fresh chain. AGENTS.md and the human boundary separately forbid implementation, model/tokenizer, data/benchmark, adapter/checkpoint, GPU/resource, external science, claims, publication, push, release, and intake transition without their later exact human authority.

visibility_failures: E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER can dereference the prior active-weight artifact although the selected personal writer is fresh from immutable birth; this is a covert prior-weight and repetition path into candidate construction.

Capabilities labeled E2, E3, E4, and E5 are directly visible in later or earlier epochs without an explicit close-and-reissue edge, contradicting the one-epoch invariant and permitting stale-handle reuse.
E1_BIRTH_WRITER has no capability for the exact writer, merge, tokenizer, serializer, or toolchain contract that its loop declares as an input, forcing ambient authority.
Dependency manifests, taint receipts, lineage receipts, candidate-preservation evidence, narrow attestations, and release-root bindings are not fully producer-closed inside the 17-stage product.
E8_TRANSFER_OPAQUE_RELEASE_TARGET_ARTIFACT uses an operation absent from the registry and release loop, and its root-only binding does not prevent artifact-class or destination substitution.
FIRST_AFFECTED_ACTION_REGISTRY has no stage/capability or noncircular bootstrap path, while ES19/ES20 require machinery whose implementation they themselves precede.

The support resolver may authorize a multi-evidence generalized target without proving the generalized proposition was child-authored, creating a compiler-to-gradient teaching path inconsistent with the system thesis.
missing_acceptance_tests: Modify V5_ES03/V5_ES14 with a prior-weight denial fixture proving E4 candidate bytes are invariant to prior active adapter mutation and every personal candidate initializes only from the immutable birth.
Modify V5_ES19 with producer-consumer epoch transitions: close original handles, issue attenuated per-consumer handles, reject copied/replayed/stale handles, and verify constant-shape failures.
Extend V5_ES03/V2_ES05 with an E1 frozen writer-merge-tokenizer-serializer-toolchain capability and ambient-configuration taint failure.
Extend V5_ES19 with producer-closure generation from the registry, requiring one explicit producer or declared external source and narrowing transform for every readable E7/E8 object.
Extend V5_ES01/V5_ES21 with registered opaque transfer and an equality-bound release tuple covering root, artifact class, destination, operation, protocol, scope, nonce, expiry, and idempotency.
Replace V5_ES21 with a machine-readable action-to-prerequisite DAG and a separately ratified model-free harness bootstrap proving no protected domain action is needed to create its own gate receipt.
Extend V5_ES02/V5_ES13 with clause-level authorship fixtures that reject compiler-synthesized generalizations and distinguish child-authored correction from merely grounded premises.
human_questions: Will Rohin require successor bytes rather than interpretation-side repair for all seven blockers: prior-weight access, cross-epoch handles, missing E1 contract capability, producer-incomplete E7/E8 objects, unregistered and weakly bound release, circular action gating, and generalized-target authorship?
Does personal SLEEP always train a fresh zero-effective-delta adapter from immutable birth, with prior active weights visible only to E5 preservation evaluation?
Should persistent artifacts cross epochs only through explicit close-and-reissue attenuation, and must every E7/E8 receipt or attestation have a declared producer and narrowing transform?

May SLEEP train a generalized proposition only if the child previously authored that proposition, or does Rohin intend compiler-authored generalization as an explicit additional teaching intervention?
Will release authority bind the complete artifact-class/destination/operation/scope/nonce/expiry/idempotency tuple and use a registered opaque-transfer operation?

Will exact capability schemas, implementation transactions, data generators, statistical power and inference, writer/replay controls, GPU packets, claims, publication, push, and release remain separately byte-bound and human-authorized after architectural rework?
